readings.moment: The temple bell struck nine, when Uncle had everyone put their watches on the cloth.
When the temple bell struck nine (twenty minutes to nine by Félix's watch).
A quarter past ten, when someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door.
Eighteen minutes past ten, when Félix heard a thump in the atelier above the library.
The uncle's repeater sounded ten slow deep notes after the thump, which strike the hour of ten.
Twenty-one minutes past ten, when someone came quickly down.
Thirty-two minutes past ten, when Bastien Girard came into the library.
The temple struck eleven, when Félix and Girard had been sitting together in the library.

durations: Félix and Bastien Girard sat together in the library from 10:32 until the temple struck eleven, which is 28 minutes.
whereabouts: Monsieur Félix Monnier was at dinner, where his uncle asked to see inside his watch.
At nine o'clock, Félix was among those whose watches were put on the cloth at the uncle's request.
Félix went up to the library after dinner.
Félix stayed in the library alone.
At 10:15 by Félix's watch, someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door.
Félix stayed in the library after hearing the thump.
Félix was alone in the library directly below the atelier.
At 10:21 by Félix's watch, someone came quickly down; Félix did not see who.
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 by Félix's watch.
Bastien Girard sat with Félix in the library until the temple struck eleven.
Bastien Girard was at dinner, where he quarrelled with Aurèle Monnier about the repeater.
Aurèle Monnier was found dead in his atelier.
